fusions.name: Gathered Charge
fusions.desc: A blow from the full stride that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Thunder Pass
fusions.desc: Sweeps past every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 14 damage and knocking them back 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Steady Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and you have 10% physical resistance.
